movers.text: Wisconsin guard Jack Janicki (17.8 mpg) hurt his foot in the Murray State loss and will have season-ending surgery, Greg Gard said; Wisconsin is down to 12 available players.
Florida's Boogie Fland (25.2 mpg, nagging shoulder) is out vs Milwaukee on 11/24, his second straight missed game, per the Gators' preview; Denzel Aberdeen runs the point.
Texas PG Isaiah Johnson (24.2 mpg) left the Southern Indiana win after about four minutes with a glute strain; Sean Miller says his status for the Thanksgiving tournament is unknown.
Pat Kelsey says Seth Trimble (28 mpg) will play vs Texas Tech on 11/24 after missing the Stetson win with a minor injury.
Michigan State's Coen Carr (21.8 mpg, knee tendinitis) was a full participant in Monday's practice after sitting the last two games; Izzo expects him back for Arkansas on Thanksgiving.

Michigan State starter Jordan Scott (23.4 mpg, right shoulder) practiced in a limited role Monday after missing the last two games; not yet confirmed for the Arkansas game.

Louisville.text: Pat Kelsey says Seth Trimble (28 mpg) will play vs Texas Tech on 11/24 after missing the Stetson win with a minor injury.
Louisville reserve guard Isaac Ellis (13.5 mpg, ankle, hurt vs Stetson) will miss the Players Era Festival; Kelsey: "We do not expect him to play this week at all."

Tennessee.text: Tennessee's Jalen Haralson (20.5 mpg, right knee hyperextension 11/17) missed Coastal Carolina, and game-day reports on 11/24 said he was expected to sit vs Maryland.

Syracuse.text: Syracuse PG Garwey Dual (24.2 mpg) hurt his right ankle vs Lafayette on 11/21 and sat the second half in a walking boot; X-rays ordered, no status yet for UAlbany on 11/25.

North Carolina.text: Starter Neo Avdalas (24 mpg, team-high 3.8 apg) fractured his left wrist vs. Georgia and had surgery; UNC says he is out about two months (announced 11/17).
